changeSet.author: communications-cliniques
changeSet.comment: Réponses prédéfinies, modèles, alertes et remises.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE alr_reponses ( id TEXT NOT NULL, tenantId TEXT NOT NULL, libelle TEXT NOT NULL, semantique TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY (tenantId, id) )
CREATE TABLE alr_modeles ( id TEXT NOT NULL, tenantId TEXT NOT NULL, titre TEXT NOT NULL, corps TEXT NOT NULL, priorite TEXT NOT NULL, actif INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY (tenantId, id) )
CREATE TABLE alr_modele_reponses ( tenantId TEXT NOT NULL, modeleId TEXT NOT NULL, rang INTEGER NOT NULL, reponseId TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenantId, modeleId, rang) )

CREATE TABLE alr_alertes ( id TEXT NOT NULL, tenantId TEXT NOT NULL, titre TEXT NOT NULL, corps TEXT NOT NULL, priorite TEXT NOT NULL, expediteurId TEXT NOT NULL, envoyeeLe TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenantId, id) )

CREATE TABLE alr_alerte_reponses ( tenantId TEXT NOT NULL, alerteId TEXT NOT NULL, rang INTEGER NOT NULL, reponseId TEXT NOT NULL, libelle TEXT NOT NULL, semantique TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenantId, alerteId, rang) )

CREATE TABLE alr_remises ( tenantId TEXT NOT NULL, alerteId TEXT NOT NULL, personId TEXT NOT NULL, nom TEXT NOT NULL, compteAvis TEXT, envoyeeLe TEXT NOT NULL, lueLe TEXT, reponseId TEXT, reponduLe TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (tenantId, alerteId, personId) )
CREATE INDEX idx_alr_remises_personne ON alr_remises (tenantId, personId)
CREATE INDEX idx_alr_alertes_envoi ON alr_alertes (tenantId, envoyeeLe)
